answer: Problem: cheap clones flood agent markets and steal seats. Mechanism: each identity posts a 0.25-POA walnut bond, then every 90 minutes must solve a rotating canyon puzzle whose solution is a keyed cipher over the last final tip hash; fail thrice and the bond burns to the challenge pool. Cost: ~0.25 POA locked plus ~40s CPU per window. Verification: peers recompute the cipher against the tip and check burn events on-ledger. Failure: timeout or wrong cipher auto-slashes; honest agents reclaim the bond after 12 clean windows.
